title: Concept Hierarchy
description: JSON Schema for validating a Concept Hierarchy

concepts.title: Concept Hierarchy Concepts
concepts.description: JSON Schema for validating concept definitions in the Concept Hierarchy

^external$.description: Array of relative paths to external .ch files to include

^(?!Concept$)[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$.description: Concept definition (name must start with uppercase)

description.description: Human-readable description of the root concept

directParents.description: Array of parent concept names of the root concept; should be empty (root has no parents)!

data.description: Concept data of the root concept: either a path to external file OR an object with concept-specific data

oneOf.description: Path to external file containing the root concept's data

conceptContent.description: Content of a concept: either a reference to another concept or a full definition

oneOf.description: Reference to another concept (aliasing)
Full concept definition

data.description: Concept data: either a path to external file OR an object with concept-specific data

oneOf.description: Path to external file containing concept data

conceptDataSeparate.description: Concept data object - can contain domain concept, ValueDomain, or Function specific data

conceptData.$comment: If using conceptDataSeparate and if there is an error in the concept data definition, then the errors will be shown totally wrong... So, accept that validation of the keys will be done in the parser and this is an incomplete, but still useful helper for development with the Concept Hierarchy.
conceptData.description: Concept data object - can contain domain concept, ValueDomain, or Function specific data

conceptReference.description: Reference to a concept (must start with uppercase letter; concepts specified without template args)

argumentReference.description: Argument name (must start with lowercase letter, cannot be a reserved keyword)

variableReference.description: Variable name (must start with a letter)

templateArgumentDefinition.description: Template argument name (must start with uppercase, may end with ... for variadic)

instantiatedValueDomain.description: Instantiated ValueDomain reference with optional template arguments

instantiatedFunction.description: Instantiated Function reference with optional template arguments

oneOf.description: Maps ValueDomain to a JSON primitive type for serialization

CHSchema.title: CH schema
CHSchema.description: A CH schema value. Accepts boolean (draft-07 boolean schema), string (type-name shorthand), array (custom-type + ref-kind shorthand), or full object form. Custom type validity and ref-placement rules are enforced at runtime by CHSchemaContext.

CHSchemaArrayShorthand.title: CH array shorthand
CHSchemaArrayShorthand.description: ['<custom type name>', 'Reference'|'NoRef'] — valid only when the type name is NOT a draft-07 builtin. Builtin-type array shorthands are rejected at runtime.

CHSchemaObject.title: CH schema object
CHSchemaObject.description: Full object form. Adds 'ref' (Reference|NoRef) and treats 'default' as an unvalidated expression for custom types. All sub-schema positions accept CHSchema, including the string and array shorthands. additionalProperties:false enforces the keyword allowlist; stricter semantic rules (ref only on custom types, custom type name validity, etc.) are enforced at runtime.

ref.description: CH extension. Only valid when 'type' is a single custom type name; enforced at runtime.

literalTemplateVariable.description: Template variable that has a Literal: constraint!

fromJsonLiteral.description: Specifies how to deserialize a JSON literal into this ValueDomain. Either JSON null (no literal deserialization), or a string encoding the literalDeserialization DSL: a '|'-separated list of literal alternatives, where element/value types may be primitives, array, object, or a concept name (upperCaseName).

oneOf.description: No JSON deserialization from literal defined

literalDeserializationSyntaxString.description: A string encoding a literalDeserialization expression: one or more '|'-separated literal alternatives. Element and value types (typeAndLiteralDeserialization) may be any literal type expression OR a bare concept name (upperCaseName starting with uppercase).

domainConceptProperties.description: Container for concept properties and specializations

propertyDefinition.description: Property definition: either just the ValueDomain name or a full definition object

topLevelPropertySpecializationContent.description: Container for property specializations (contains per-property specializations for subconcepts and the _forThis definition)

durationValue.description: Duration: either a number or [number, unit]

domainConceptFunctions.description: Container for concept functions and specializations

domainFunctionDefinition.description: Domain function: can be a procedure, custom function, or full definition

customFunctionDefinition.description: Custom function definition with interface and procedure

topLevelFunctionSpecializationsContainer.description: Container for function specializations (contains per-function specializations for subconcepts and the _forThis definition)

templateContext.description: Definition of a ValueDomain's template context

oneOf.description: Shorthand: array of template argument names
Full definition with order, constraints, substitution

order.description: The order in which template variable are to be specified in instantiations of this type.

templateArgumentConstraintValue.description: The value that can be written wherever a template variable constraint is expected.

oneOf.description: Template variable literal constraint
Template variable literal value constraint of type Literal:integer
Template variable literal value constraint of type Literal:number
Template variable literal value constraint of type Literal:boolean
Template variable literal value constraint of type Literal:string
Template variable type constraint (including the empty string that maps to unconstrained)
String literal value enclosed in quotes "..." to distinguish from ValueDomain instantiations
Single interface
Multiple interfaces

functionProcedure.description: Function procedure: a JSON object with function name as key. RECURSION POINT - add maxDepth here if needed

isFunctionEvaluation.description: Disambiguates function evaluation from procedure definition

valueDomainCreation.description: ValueDomain creation/instantiation. RECURSION POINT - add maxDepth here if needed

oneOf.description: Object syntax
Array syntax

functionInversion.description: Maps function arguments to their inversion procedures

functionUpdateScope.description: Variables to add to existing scope

functionSubScopes.description: New variable scopes for function arguments

anyValue.description: Any JSON value, ValueDomain creation, or Function procedure. RECURSION POINT - add maxDepth here if needed

oneOf.description: Could be plain JSON object, ValueDomain creation, or Function procedure

instances.title: Concept Hierarchy Instances
instances.description: JSON Schema for validating instance definitions in the Concept Hierarchy

^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$.description: Instance = Global variable (can start with upper or lowercase letter)

instanceDefinition.description: Value of an instance: can be any JSON value, ValueDomain creation, Function procedure, or reference to another instance

oneOf.description: Either a string literal (with s: prefix) or reference to another instance
Could be: plain JSON object, ValueDomain creation, Function procedure, or CustomFunction definition. RECURSION POINT - add maxDepth here if needed
